body.name: Row-major global experiment filtration
body.construction: Order \(\mathcal C_{n,m}=I\times J\) by \(o(i,j)=(i-1)m+j\). Let \(\mathbb G_0\) be the recorded baseline field and let \(\mathbb G_k\) be the field after recording the assignment and outcome at the unique cell \(o^{-1}(k)\), together with all earlier cells. Define \(\mathcal F_{i,0}=\mathbb G_{(i-1)m}\) and \(\mathcal F_{i,j}=\mathbb G_{o(i,j)}\) for \(j\in J\).
inputs: The row and time indices and the recorded cell sequence.
